title: Public Integrity Forensics: An Auditable Multi-Source Agent for Corruption-Risk Screening from Open Data
domain: public integrity / China internet mining / hospitals / SOEs / research institutes / universities / NGOs / public procurement / corporate networks / audit / entity resolution / graph analytics
summary: An auditable multi-source public-integrity agent that mines structured and web-native public records across government, hospitals, SOEs, research institutes, universities, NGOs/social organizations and suppliers, builds a time-aware evidence graph, and produces reproducible human-review leads without equating anomalies, public-office status, organizational identity or web allegations with corruption.

aris.provenance: ARIS4C guided design; inherits the evidence semantics and detector-contract principles of ARIS4C011; live public-data source audit on 2026-09-18
